subject: Joint technical pairing — next steps & proposed slots
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@novagsi.com>, Michael Huang <michael.huang@cloudcrest.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Joint technical pairing — next steps & proposed slots

Hi Priya / Michael,

Thanks again for the discovery earlier today — great conversation and helpful context on how CloudCrest wants to surface marketplace listings and how NovaGSI will support technical enablement. Quick recap + suggested next steps so we can lock a joint technical pairing: 

Summary (minutes):
- Goal: Validate integration approach for CloudCrest marketplace connector (auth, telemetry, billing events) and surface minimal end-to-end demo for customers.
- Success criteria: ability to run a 3-step demo (deploy model, ingest sample data, run a live inference) and a clear rollout path for production traffic.

Proposed next step: 60–75 min joint technical deep dive with: CloudCrest engineer + NovaGSI integration lead + Redwood solutions engineer (Camila) + one sales rep (Ben). We’ll cover architecture, auth patterns, and a dry-run of the demo runbook.

Availability (PST) — pick one:
- Tue Jan 20, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Jan 21, 14:00–15:15
- Thu Jan 22, 09:00–10:15

I’ve attached a short PoC brief and a draft demo runbook so everyone can scan before the session. If none of the above work, please propose two windows and we’ll try to match.

Next steps from our side after the call: prepare a thin architecture diagram for the demo, confirm any sandbox credentials required, and create a shared runbook doc with concrete checkboxes.

Thanks — looking forward to pairing.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Alliances Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: cloudcrest-poc-brief.pdf (PDF, 450KB); joint-demo-runbook.md (Markdown); redwood-mvp-arch.png (PNG)
From: Priya Rao <priya@novagsi.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Huang <michael.huang@cloudcrest.io>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Joint technical pairing — next steps & proposed slots

Jonas — thanks for the recap and the materials. That summary is perfect.

Michael and I reviewed the runbook quickly and shared with our integration lead (Ayesha) — she’s keen to join the deep dive but has limited windows next week. Of your proposed slots, the only one that reliably works for us is Wed Jan 21, 14:00–15:15 PST. Can you lock that?

Agenda items we’d like to add (quick):
- Confirmation of OAuth vs API-key flow for the marketplace connector (15 mins)
- Sandbox data shape and a sample payload (10 mins)
- Telemetry/events contract for billing reconciliation (10 mins)
- Dry-run of the minimal 3-step demo (remaining time)

We’ll attach a short list of sandbox access requirements before the call. Can you send a calendar invite with attendee list + agenda and add a Google Drive link for the runbook?

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Head of Integrations | NovaGSI
priya@novagsi.com | +1 917-555-3348
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya@novagsi.com>, Michael Huang <michael.huang@cloudcrest.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Joint technical pairing — next steps & proposed slots

Priya — great, Wed Jan 21 14:00–15:15 PST is confirmed on our side. I’ve penciled in Camila (solutions) and Ben (sales) — Camila will drive the demo runbook, Ben will cover commercial questions.

I created a shared Drive folder and uploaded the runbook + PoC brief: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-demo-runbook
HubSpot deal: https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/CC-2026-0417 (Ben — please update the contact record with Ayesha once she’s on the invite).

Agenda (finalized):
1) Intros & objective alignment (5 mins)
2) Auth & connector pattern (15 mins) — Camila + Ayesha
3) Sandbox data & sample payload (10 mins) — Michael
4) Telemetry/events contract (10 mins) — Priya
5) Dry-run demo of the 3-step flow (35 mins)
6) Action items / PoC deliverables & ownership (10 mins)

I’ll send the calendar invite now and include an ICS link with dial-in. If you want any pre-reads, flag them here and I’ll surface them to the team.

Jonas
